events.description: Spun out of full-sweep audit on 2026-05-19 (C6 critical). Tech still named Feraldis_IronFury, mentions Iron not Veilsteel, and no carry system exists at all.

events.title: Tech rename + component
events.description: TechTree.json: Feraldis_IronFury renamed to Feraldis_VeilsteelFrenzy with description 'Military units carry Veilsteel shavings from kills (max 5); each grants +2% attack (stacks to +10%)' and researchAt: WarHall. New Core/Components/VeilsteelCarryComponent.cs defines VeilsteelCarry { byte Shavings } in global namespace.

Phases 2-3 deferred: Phase 2 (kill-drop + attack-bonus systems) needs careful composition with existing UnitRankSystem + EquipmentTierSystem stamp/diff pattern to avoid double-applying multipliers. Phase 3 (research UI gate at WarHall) depends on task-071 cultured rename layer for the WarHall building identity. R6 (caravan-kill shaving award) requires adding LastAttackerEntity tracking to caravans, which is more invasive than this pass. Suggest implementing Phases 2-3 as a single PR once task-071 lands and a damage-multiplier composition design is locked.
